KreditBee.summary: Platform for partner-provided loans, with a separate UPI payment service inside the app.

sources.title: Personal Loans for Salaried Employees Online | KreditBee
sources.supports: Salaried-loan employment, age, income and documentation requirements; approval is not guaranteed by meeting the salary threshold. The older personal-loan-for-salaried URL redirects here.

sources.title: KreditBee FAQs: Answers to Common Questions
sources.supports: Live search-indexed official FAQ text gives an 18-year minimum, no upper age limit, and says loan eligibility varies. Direct extraction returned an empty page.

sources.title: Personal Loan Eligibility Calculator Online | KreditBee
sources.supports: General personal-loan calculator lists Indian citizenship, ages 21–60 and minimum monthly income of ₹10,000; a calculator result is only an estimate.

sources.title: KreditBee UPI — Instant Payments & Rewards | KreditBee
sources.supports: Separate UPI payments, account linking, mobile verification and PIN setup; supports bank payments and optional card/credit-line payments.

claims.label: Product
claims.text: KreditBee facilitates loans through lending partners and also offers UPI transfers and merchant payments.

claims.label: Intended users
claims.text: Borrowers, including salaried applicants for the named salary product; UPI payment users are a separate use case.

claims.label: Eligibility — salaried personal loan
claims.text: The product page specifies Indian citizenship, age above 21, regular/permanent employment, three months with the current company, salary of at least ₹10,000 monthly and household income above ₹25,000 monthly. It requests PAN, photo, address, employment and salary-bank-statement evidence, plus an Aadhaar-linked mobile number. Credit assessment still applies.

claims.label: Eligibility — conflicting loan pages
claims.text: The FAQ states a minimum age of 18 with no upper limit; the general calculator instead states 21–60 and minimum monthly income of ₹10,000. The salaried product has additional criteria. These sources do not establish one universal app-wide age or income rule.

claims.label: Eligibility — UPI
claims.text: Download the app, verify the mobile number, link a bank account and set a UPI PIN. The UPI page does not make taking a loan a prerequisite.

unknowns: The FAQ's indexed age rules conflict with the loan pages; its direct extraction was empty, so relative freshness is uncertain.
A single authoritative age boundary and lender-specific underwriting cutoff were not established. Salaried-loan KYC and credit gates apply to that loan, not automatically to UPI.
A separate numerical minimum age for standalone KreditBee UPI was not established.

RapiPay.summary: Assisted payments and banking services offered through retailer agents called Direct Business Outlets.

sources.title: Get RapiPay Agent ID | Trusted by Lakhs of Retailers PAN India
sources.supports: Agent/retailer product, enquiry by mobile number, smartphone/computer access, and assisted AePS, Micro ATM, remittance and bill-payment services.

sources.title: RapiPay – KYC & AML Policy
sources.supports: Published policy separates agent onboarding from customer KYC; agent activation requires verification and approval of identity/address information and photographs.

claims.label: Product
claims.text: Retail outlets can provide assisted cash withdrawal, money transfer, bill payment and other partner services through RapiPay.

claims.label: Intended users
claims.text: Retailers and businesses seeking to operate a RapiPay Direct Business Outlet; customers visiting an outlet are a different role.

claims.label: Eligibility — agent account
claims.text: The joining page invites retailer/agent enquiries using a mobile number and says a smartphone or computer can be used. The published KYC policy describes document verification and approval before an agent can log in.

claims.label: Eligibility — agent documents
claims.text: For an agent added under an existing agent, the policy lists PAN, address proof and a live photograph holding the identity documents. RapiPay's reviewer must approve the request. This is agent onboarding, not a universal consumer-wallet checklist.

unknowns: A current binding minimum agent age, complete fee/working-capital schedule and service-specific hardware checklist were not established.
The public KYC PDF has an older revision-style filename; whether its exact agent workflow remains unchanged needs confirmation from current onboarding.
Research identifies RapiPay's India retailer service; it does not substitute the separate NYE consumer product or similarly named overseas services.

Spice Money.summary: Retailer-assisted financial services through Spice Money Adhikari outlets.

sources.title: Become a Spice Money Banking Agent and Earn Commissions
sources.supports: Shop-based Adhikari services and a specific onboarding sequence: app registration, identity/bank/shop details, physical shop verification and approval.

claims.label: Product
claims.text: Adhikari outlets offer assisted withdrawals, transfers, bills, recharges and distribution of other financial products.

claims.label: Intended users
claims.text: Shop owners seeking to operate an assisted-service outlet for their customers.

claims.label: Eligibility — Adhikari onboarding
claims.text: Register in the app with a mobile number and submit shop address, PAN, Aadhaar and bank details. A sales/distributor representative verifies the shop and KYC details; the onboarding team must approve the application before agent credentials are issued.

unknowns: A numerical minimum agent age, binding joining-fee schedule and required working capital were not established from this page.
Hardware and eligibility can differ by service; the agent joining instructions do not establish each customer's AePS, lending or insurance eligibility.
Marketing earnings examples are not verified or guaranteed agent income.

Saathi by PayNearby.summary: Consumer UPI payments, bill payments and mutual-fund investing, with nearby-retailer support.

sources.title: Saathi by PayNearby:UPI,Saving - Apps on Google Play
sources.supports: Developer identifies the consumer app and its UPI, recharge, bill-payment, investment and retailer-locator functions; registration uses SMS-based device verification.

sources.title: Nearby Technologies Private Limited — Data Privacy and Security Policy
sources.supports: Policy linked by the app says identity documents may be requested for verification/e-KYC. It was readable through the app-listing link; subsequent direct fetches failed.

claims.label: Product
claims.text: The developer lists sending/receiving money, QR payments, bills, recharges and mutual funds. Retailers provide optional assisted support; this listing is not the retailer-only PayNearby agent app.

claims.label: Intended users
claims.text: People making payments or investing through Saathi, including those who use nearby-retailer support.

claims.label: Eligibility — app registration
claims.text: The listing specifies SMS permission for device verification during registration. It does not publish a complete age, residency or bank-account eligibility checklist.

claims.label: Eligibility — mutual funds
claims.text: The listing advertises investments starting at ₹100, but does not establish investor-age, guardian, KYC or scheme-specific joining rules.

claims.label: Verification — scope
claims.text: The linked privacy policy permits identity-document requests for verification/e-KYC. It does not establish mandatory full KYC for every Saathi feature.

unknowns: Standalone UPI minimum age, eligible account types and exact bank/mobile-linking steps were not verified in product-specific terms.
Mutual-fund provider, investor eligibility and complete investment onboarding requirements remain unverified.
No evidence supports requiring agent membership or an agent-assisted visit for every consumer.

Dhani.summary: The current official site markets short-term personal loans for salaried applicants.

sources.title: Dhani – Instant Personal Loan up to ₹1.5 Lakh for Salaried
sources.supports: Current salary-loan positioning, applicant age/citizenship and document requirements; names Dhani Loans and Services Limited as lender and makes approval dependent on credit policy.

claims.label: Product
claims.text: A digital personal-loan application and repayment service; the site names Dhani Loans and Services Limited as the lender.

claims.label: Intended users
claims.text: Salaried people applying for the short-term personal loan currently advertised.

claims.label: Eligibility — advertised personal loan
claims.text: Indian citizens aged 21–58, receiving salary into a bank account, with PAN linked to Aadhaar and an Aadhaar-linked mobile number. The site lists PAN-based identity/credit checks, Aadhaar OTP e-KYC, a bank statement and an in-app selfie. Approval depends on the lender's credit policy.

unknowns: Minimum salary and minimum credit score are not stated in the inspected eligibility section.
The lender's separate website returned no readable text, so a complete binding loan agreement was not verified.

Legacy credit-line, shopping or health-product descriptions were not corroborated as current offerings by the inspected page. These loan criteria do not establish eligibility for any separate Dhani payments product.

Fave.summary: Pine Labs' India app combines UPI payments with shared household expenses and bill splitting.

sources.title: Fave UPI: Track, Split & Pay - Apps on Google Play
sources.supports: Identifies the India app and developer; describes UPI, family/partner/flatmate expense sharing and recurring bill tracking.

sources.title: fave — The UPI app for the people you live with
sources.supports: Current shared-spending positioning and iOS/Android availability; does not publish a detailed joining checklist.

claims.label: Product
claims.text: UPI payments with shared expense tracking, splitting and a household bill calendar.

claims.label: Intended users
claims.text: Families, partners and flatmates managing money together, as explicitly described by the developer.

claims.label: Identity — market and app
claims.text: This research concerns Pine Labs' India app, package com.pinelabs.faveindiaandroid. The short name Fave alone does not uniquely identify a market or product.

claims.label: Eligibility — Fave India
claims.text: The reviewed India website and developer listing do not establish a minimum age, complete registration process or accepted identity documents. The website advertises iOS and Android availability.

unknowns: Current India-specific age, residency, supported bank-account types, SIM-linking and verification requirements were not established; no default 18+ rule is asserted.
A guessed India terms URL was inaccessible. Malaysia/Singapore merchant terms were not substituted for India consumer eligibility.
The inspected current pages do not substantiate a universal cashback promise or an urban/wealth demographic.

True Balance.summary: Digital access to partner-provided loans, alongside advertised UPI-enabled wallet payments.

sources.title: Personal Loan App in India — Apply Online | True Balance
sources.supports: Personal-loan purpose, Indian citizenship, minimum age 18, identity/address documents, PAN/Aadhaar and formal credit assessment.

sources.title: Get Instant Cash: True Balance Offers a Convenient Cash Loan App
sources.supports: Cash-loan application requires KYC, bank statements, bank details and auto-debit setup; loan application involves lender assessment.

sources.title: Loan Help at True Balance: Application to NOC
sources.supports: Loan registration/PAN KYC, lender-specific underwriting and one-active-loan restriction.

sources.title: True Balance - Loan App & UPI - Apps on Google Play
sources.supports: Developer distinguishes lending, credit information and UPI-enabled wallet payments; identifies the app package.

claims.label: Product
claims.text: The app facilitates loans from True Credits and lending partners; its developer also advertises UPI-enabled wallet transfers and merchant payments.

claims.label: Intended users
claims.text: People seeking personal borrowing and people using the advertised payment features. The sources do not restrict the app to first-time borrowers or non-metro residents.

claims.label: Eligibility — personal loan
claims.text: The product page lists Indian citizenship, age 18 or older, valid identity/address proof, PAN and Aadhaar. Complete KYC and check the offered loan; formal application includes a credit check, while an indicative pre-check is described as soft.

claims.label: Eligibility — Cash Loan
claims.text: Register a phone number, complete KYC, provide the requested bank statement and bank details, and set up auto-debit. Approval depends on the lender's assessment; these are loan-specific steps.

claims.label: Eligibility — repeat borrowing
claims.text: The help page permits one active loan at a time. Repayment allows a subsequent application; lender underwriting still determines approval.

unknowns: No universal minimum income, upper age or minimum bureau score was established for all lenders and loan variants.
Detailed Level Up Loan eligibility was not established separately.
Standalone UPI/wallet joining and KYC-tier rules were not verified. The listed KYC and credit gates describe loans, not every payment feature.

Payworld.summary: Retailer platform for assisted payments, banking transactions and travel-related services.

sources.title: Payworld - AEPS, Air, Irctc - Apps on Google Play
sources.supports: Developer explicitly describes a retailer/merchant app offering assisted cash withdrawals, remittances, bills, recharges and bookings.

sources.title: Payworld Retailer Terms & Conditions
sources.publisher: Payworld / Sugal & Damani Utility Services Private Limited
sources.supports: B2B retailer relationship, user registration and contractual eligibility of at least 18 years; service-specific provider terms also apply.

sources.title: Payworld Retailer Register
sources.supports: Current retailer sign-up form requests mobile, email, pincode, consent, CAPTCHA and mobile/email OTP verification. Footer identifies the renamed company.

claims.label: Product
claims.text: A merchant app for providing customers with assisted AePS, transfers, bills, recharges and travel services.

claims.label: Intended users
claims.text: Retailers operating Payworld services for customers; the app is presented as a merchant/retailer platform.

claims.label: Eligibility — retailer account
claims.text: Retailer terms require users to be at least 18 and able to enter a binding contract. The current sign-up form requests mobile number, email and pincode, with mobile/email OTPs and consent. Registering is separate from satisfying any additional service-provider terms.

claims.label: Identity — operator
claims.text: The current registration footer names Payworld Digital Services Private Limited, formerly Sugal & Damani Utility Services Private Limited; the retailer terms still use the former name.

unknowns: The complete current retailer KYC document list, activation approval steps, fees and operating-balance requirements were not established.
Individual services can require separate equipment or authorisation; retailer signup does not establish customer or IRCTC-agent eligibility.
The separate Payworld Money wallet's conditions were not applied to this retailer app.

Snapmint.summary: Cardless EMI purchase financing, with separately advertised UPI payments and personal loans for premium customers.

sources.title: 0% EMI Shopping App - Apps on Google Play
sources.supports: Developer describes EMI without a credit card, UPI for eligible users and personal loans for premium customers as separate offerings.

sources.title: Snapmint Terms and Conditions
sources.supports: Account registration, legal capacity, eligibility checks and required verifications/KYC; financing is subject to assessment by Snapmint and/or financial partners.

sources.title: Master Terms and Conditions for Purchase Limit Membership — May 2025
sources.supports: Lender's purchase-limit terms: minimum age 18, contractual/insolvency conditions, discretionary approval, possible PAN/Aadhaar/phone requests and repayment mandate.

claims.label: Product
claims.text: Purchase financing on EMI without needing a credit card. The developer separately lists Snapmint UPI and premium-customer personal loans.

claims.label: Intended users
claims.text: Shoppers seeking instalment financing, including those without credit cards; some additional services are restricted to eligible or premium users.

claims.label: Eligibility — purchase limit / EMI loan
claims.text: Lender terms require age 18+, legal capacity and satisfaction of insolvency/other contractual conditions. Purchase-limit approval is discretionary. PAN, Aadhaar and phone details may be requested; required KYC/verifications and a repayment mandate apply to financing.

claims.label: Eligibility — personal loan
claims.text: The developer listing limits the advertised personal-loan offer to premium customers. It does not establish that every new EMI shopper qualifies.

claims.label: Eligibility — Snapmint UPI
claims.text: The developer says UPI is available to eligible users, without publishing a complete standalone joining checklist in that listing. EMI-loan criteria must not automatically be applied to UPI.

unknowns: Minimum income and bureau-score thresholds, the premium-customer qualification formula and individual credit limits were not established.
Standalone UPI age/account requirements were not verified. KYC and credit gates here are scoped to purchase financing.
A marketing no-cost EMI label does not establish zero fees or zero interest for every purchase or personal-loan offer.

ZET.summary: App offering bank-issued credit cards backed by fixed deposits, including the SBM ZET card.

sources.title: ZET FD Credit Card | Secured Credit Card Against FD | Build Credit Score Fast
sources.supports: Current FD-backed-card positioning and named banking partners SBM Bank India, Indian Overseas Bank and DCB Bank.

sources.title: SBM ZET Credit Card - Build 750+ Credit Score with UPI Credit Card
sources.supports: SBM-specific application, FD, video KYC and approval sequence; advertises no prior credit history/income proof and an FD starting at ₹2,000.

sources.title: SBM ZET Credit Card — Card Member Agreement
sources.supports: Issuer conditions for KYC, sole-name FD created through ZET, lien and secured-card issuance; clause 18.3 specifies a ₹5,000 minimum FD.

claims.label: Product
claims.text: Secured credit cards against fixed deposits held with named partner banks. The deposit is collateral for the card, rather than an unsecured loan offer.

claims.label: Intended users
claims.text: Card applicants building credit, including people without prior credit history; ZET's SBM page says income proof is not needed.

claims.label: Eligibility — SBM ZET secured card
claims.text: Create the required FD through ZET and complete video KYC and bank approval. The issuer requires an eligible deposit in the individual's sole name and marks a lien before activating the card. This is specific to the SBM-issued card.

claims.label: Eligibility — conflicting minimum deposit
claims.text: The current SBM product page advertises an FD from ₹2,000; the inspected issuer agreement's clause 18.3 instead requires at least ₹5,000. The applicable minimum is unresolved and must be checked against the actual issuer offer/agreement.

unknowns: The ₹2,000 versus ₹5,000 SBM deposit discrepancy was not reconciled; neither amount is asserted as a settled universal ZET requirement.
Card-specific age/residency limits and current IOB/DCB eligibility were not established from inspected issuer documents.
No guaranteed future credit score or guaranteed approval is established. FD/KYC gates concern secured-card issuance, not every ZET feature.

Navi.summary: UPI payments app with access to loans, mutual funds and insurance through separate service providers.

sources.title: Navi UPI Payments | Secure & Fast Online Money Transfer
sources.supports: UPI payments and onboarding; distinguishes bank payments, optional RuPay card use and Navi Trezo credit-line functionality.

sources.title: Navi App Terms Of Use — updated July 21, 2026
sources.supports: App registration and separate UPI, mutual-fund and insurance conditions, including account/SIM linking and provider-specific verification.

sources.title: Navi Finserv Limited Terms of Use — Cash Loan
sources.supports: Personal-loan household-income rule, contractual capacity, information/KYC, bank verification and lender approval. Linked from the current Finserv site.

sources.title: Navi Fintech Private Limited — Terms & Conditions for Credit Line on UPI
sources.supports: Credit-line-specific household-income threshold, lender discretion and KYC; reached through the current Navi UPI page's Trezo terms link.

claims.label: Product
claims.text: Payments and provider-specific lending, investment and insurance services share one app.

claims.label: Intended users
claims.text: Payment users, borrowers and investors, depending on the service chosen.

claims.label: Eligibility — Navi account
claims.text: Create a profile using a phone number verified by OTP; users must be legally able to contract.

claims.label: Eligibility — bank-account UPI
claims.text: India resident; active participating-bank account linked to the mobile number. Registration sends SMS from the device, whose linked SIM must remain active. These UPI rules do not impose the personal-loan income threshold.

claims.label: Eligibility — Finserv personal loan
claims.text: Cash Loan terms require legal capacity and annual household income above ₹3,00,000. Requested information/documents, lender-approved KYC, bank verification and credit approval apply to the loan. The household definition covers spouses and unmarried adult children.

claims.label: Eligibility — Navi Trezo / credit line on UPI
claims.text: The linked CLOU terms require legal capacity and annual household income above ₹1,20,000. Partner lenders decide credit approval and undertake KYC. This credit-line rule differs from both ordinary bank-account UPI and the Finserv personal loan.

claims.label: Eligibility — mutual funds
claims.text: Requested investor details/documents include PAN and Aadhaar; KYC/CKYC compliance and scheme documents apply separately.

claims.label: Eligibility — insurance
claims.text: App terms specify Indian nationality, legal capacity and not being politically exposed. The insurer decides acceptance under the policy documents.

unknowns: Loan-specific age limits, minimum personal salary and bureau-score cutoff were not established; household income is not the same as an individual salary.
Exact health-policy age/coverage criteria and scheme-specific investment limits were not assessed.
Credit gates concern personal loans/Trezo; investment and lending KYC rules are not asserted as a full-KYC prerequisite for ordinary bank-account UPI.
The CLOU PDF is linked from the current product page, but its filename dates from an older version; individual offers and executed lender terms may differ.
